record.body:
## Description

R7: `orchestra init` creates the store through `open_backend`.
R8: `dashboard/backend/store.py` lists records through the `Project` API.
R9: A record reference in a derived view shows the record id with no file link.
R10: No module outside `orchestra/canon/` imports `Store`.
R11: No module outside `orchestra/canon/` opens a file under the store root.

## Approach

Replace direct Store creation in orchestra init with the factory; route dashboard listing and suite configuration through Project. Render record ids without filesystem links. Add a seeded boundary regression for external imports and record-root file reads, excluding unrelated sessions home-store discovery and tuner audit policy. Update affected expectations.

payload.title: Move init, dashboard, suite config and view references onto public APIs
